verdict.rationale: ucp.dev frames UCP as industry-governed with a co-developer list including Google, Etsy, Wayfair, Target, Walmart, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, Salesforce, and Stripe, and points to a public GitHub spec/reference implementation — suggesting more than a private Shopify integration. However, all evidence is first-party/vendor-adjacent (ucp.dev and shopify.dev) with no independent corroboration that any named party has actually shipped a working UCP implementation of their own (e.g., no Walmart or Target developer docs, no hands-on report of a second-party UCP server). Missing for 10: independent verification of at least two non-Shopify implementations actually live, third-party developer documentation or announcements from co-developer companies, and any hands-on/community confirmation of interoperability across implementations.
